facts.fact: The UN Women and Central Bureau of Statistics assessment (fieldwork March-July 2021, published 2021-12-21) treats Sudan's Statistics Act of 2003 as the current statistics law, calling it outdated and silent on gender statistics.

systems.system: National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS)

note: No rules made under or acts applied under the Act are stated; the NSDS and a new NSDS under development are class other.

facts.fact: The 2012 Sudan National Strategy for the Development of Statistics lists among the weaknesses of the national statistical system an inadequate Statistics Act and non-implementation of some of its provisions, so an act exists; the document gives no year for it, so the date is the document's September 2012 publication.

systems.system: National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2012-2016

note: SPI score only; the in-force law is already held.
